Description
Our client is a Dutch food and beverage group with dairy and plant-based brands, EUR 2.1 billion in revenue and nine production sites in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. The group has committed to science-based targets, including a 42 % reduction of Scope 3 emissions by 2030. About 85 % of its footprint sits in purchased goods and services, which makes procurement the key lever.

The procurement team (38 people, led by the CPO) has strong category management but little sustainability experience. We are looking for an interim Sustainable Procurement Lead who embeds decarbonisation into sourcing decisions and builds the supplier programme.

Responsibilities
- Build and run a supplier engagement programme for the top 150 suppliers, which account for roughly 80 % of Scope 3 emissions
- Integrate carbon and deforestation criteria into the category strategies for packaging, dairy ingredients, plant proteins and logistics
- Set up supplier data collection via CDP Supply Chain and EcoVadis and move from spend-based to supplier-specific emission factors
- Deliver the procurement-related datapoints for the CSRD report (ESRS E1 and S2) together with the sustainability and finance teams
- Update the supplier code of conduct and the due diligence process with a view to the CSDDD and the EU Deforestation Regulation (soy, palm oil, cocoa)
- Train category managers and buyers and embed sustainability KPIs into supplier reviews and tenders

Requirements
- 8+ years in strategic procurement or category management, ideally in food, beverage or FMCG
- At least 3 years of hands-on experience with sustainable procurement or supplier decarbonisation
- Solid understanding of the GHG Protocol (Scope 3 categories 1 and 4) and of supplier data platforms such as CDP or EcoVadis
- Experience in negotiating with large suppliers and in cross-functional programmes
- Fluent English; Dutch or German is a plus

Engagement
- Start: 1 November 2026
- Duration: 6 months with a realistic extension to 12 months
- Workload: 4 days per week
- Location: head office in Amsterdam-Noord or fully remote; one optional on-site day per month, travel costs reimbursed
- Rate: EUR 900 to 950 per day, excluding VAT
- Contract: freelance agreement with Oosterdok Interim B.V.; we do not offer payroll or employment for this assignment

Contact: Sanne de Kruijf, Senior Talent Partner
